components.props: {"center": true, "eyebrow": "PRICING", "title": "Open source today. Design partners first.", "lede": "The kernel, SDK, tooling, platform and benchmarks are Apache-2.0. The commercial caps and SKUs are public to read and are proofs of concept, so there are no prices and no plans yet. What exists is an invitation to build with them."}

{"id": "design-partners", "head": {"eyebrow": "DESIGN PARTNERS", "title": "Looking for two or three teams to build with.", "body": "The commercial caps and SKUs are proofs of concept. Before they are anything more, Exeris wants to build them against real use cases, with a few teams that have one."}, "columns": 2, "joined": true, "cards": [{"eyebrow": "WHAT YOU GET", "title": "Direct work with the author", "tone": "flow", "points": ["Direct work with the author, not a queue", "Early access to capabilities and SKUs as they mature", "Influence on the roadmap, starting with your use case"]}, {"eyebrow": "WHAT IS EXPECTED", "title": "A real use case and honest feedback", "tone": "cyan", "points": ["A real use case that the platform can be tried on", "Feedback: what worked, what broke, what is missing", "Permission to talk about it, in the repositories, on the blog and here"]}]}

{"id": "detachment", "alt": true, "head": {"eyebrow": "§ CODE DETACHMENT", "title": "No silent lock-in. Detach to own.", "body": "This applies to the commercial caps and SKUs only; everything that is Apache-2.0 is already yours to use and fork. The principle is that nothing you rely on is reachable only through Exeris, and the Wall guarantees there is no hidden classpath glue."}, "steps": [{"title": "Source you can read", "body": "The source of commercial caps is public to read and evaluate, so you can see what you depend on.", "tone": "cyan"}, {"title": "Operate independently", "body": "Detachment is the right to operate a version of a commercial cap or SKU without Exeris: the unsigned composition manifest and the build artifacts it needs.", "tone": "flow"}, {"title": "Terms arrive with the first release", "body": "The terms of detachment are published together with the first release of a commercial cap or SKU. Until then nothing is offered.", "tone": "slate"}]}
